build_caltech101_dataset_builder: build a tensorflow dataset builder for the Caltech-101 image classification dataset with train and test splits
create_builder_info: create dataset info with image features, class labels from a names file, and image filenames for Caltech-101
run_split_generators: run split generators to download and extract the Caltech-101 zip archive and generate train and test splits
generate_examples: generate examples by walking image directories, sampling 30 random images per class for training, and yielding image records
review_builder_class: review the GeneratorBasedBuilder class that defines the Caltech-101 dataset schema, splits, and example generation logic
